main_text.head: CAP. IV.

head.i: De patientia Iudæorum in servitute Ægyptiaca, & erga Mosen obedientia.

main_text.p: DVm in Ægypto {n}Exo.1.7. quasi germinantes & multiplicati nimis creverint Iudæi, surrexit, inquit Moses, rex novus super Aegyptum, qui ignorabat Iosephiis præposuit hic magistros operum, Exo.1.11.{o}ut affligerent eos oneribus & affligebant, illudentes iis & invidentes, atque ad amaritudinem perducebant vitam eorum operibus duris, luti & lateris omniqué familatu, quo in terra operibus premebantur. Quin & ulterius, obstetricibus imperat, ut assistentes parturientibus Hebræorum fœminis, si fœminam enixæ essent, reservarent: sin mascu-lum, statim interficerent. Mittit interea Deus ad Pharaonem, Mosen & Aaronem; tanquam Legatos à latere, qui pro populo intercederent, & veniam à terra Aegyptiaca exeundi impetrarent, sed inde Pharao pervicacior factus, & duplicatæ populo pressuræ. Dura meher-culè

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Ægypto" (the initial may be Æ or Ae); "familatu" (could be "familiatu"); the mark after "Ægypto" is a small raised letter read as "n", and the margin note beside it may carry a different letter. Italic and roman boundaries in "Iosephiis" and "Pharaonem" follow the scan. The last word "culè" is printed with a grave accent on the final e. Right-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
